THE allotment specified in the Order No. 215 of 2016 made underthe Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act(Chapter 460) and published in the Gazette Extra OrdinaryNo. 1983/34 dated 09.09.2016 is vested absolutely in the State andthe possession of which has been taken for or on behalf of the Stateunder Para (a) of Section 40 of the aforesaid Act. But by the virtue ofpowers vested in me by sub-section (1) of Section 39(a) (inserted byAct, No. 8 of 1979) of the Land Acquisition Act. I, GayanthaKarunatilleke, Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,do hereby divest only the alltoment described in the Schedule below.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
My Ref. No.: 4-3/7/2016/HW/119.Divisional Secretary’s No.: 3/3/22-1.Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Avenue,Battaramulla.11th July, 2019.

An Allotment of land depicted in the Preliminary Plan No.F.V.P. 1491 prepared by the Surveyor-General, situated in the Villagecalled Bambaragahapelessa in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 854of Godawita in the Minor Division of Rekopattu Korale in theDivisional Secretary’s Division of Weerambugedara in KurunegalaDistrict of Northwestern Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot No. 151 – Hitinawatta, Paluwatta aliasMeegahamulawatta – Extent: About 0.0333 HectareNorth: Lot Nos. 158 and 145; East: Lot Nos. 150 and 19; South:Lot Nos. 19, 34 and 152; West: Lot Nos. 152, 157 and 158.
